name: Florida
standard: Section 508 (36 C.F.R. Part 1194), which today incorporates WCAG 2.0 AA

laws.summary: State agencies must develop, buy, maintain and use IT that meets Section 508, or give alternative access if that is an undue burden.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

applies_to: State agencies, for electronic and information technology acquired on or after 2006-07-01.

deadlines.what: Section 508 conformance applies to EIT acquired on or after this date
Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Meet Section 508 for EIT acquired since 2006-07-01
Give an alternative method of access when compliance is an undue burden
mobile: not addressed — the statute does not mention mobile apps; the federal Title II rule covers them.
procurement: Procured EIT must conform to Section 508; no VPAT requirement is stated in the statute.
notes: The statute text was verified. No statewide Florida Digital Service accessibility policy or office page was found. Some vendor blogs say § 282.603 requires WCAG 2.1 AA; the text does not say that. Local governments are not covered by the statute. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
